hooks.name: Pre-Task Robotics Standards Reminder
hooks.description: Ensures the agent strictly follows robotics data standards and mathematical invariants before executing any task.

action.prompt: REMINDER: Before implementing or modifying code for this task, strictly check: 1) Frames must be sampled by integer PTS at 1.0s intervals. 2) Invariant checks must be pure functions with zero I/O side effects. 3) Any property tests must use Hypothesis with at least 100 iterations. 4) All schemas must conform to .kiro/steering/robotics-data-standards.md and .kiro/steering/audit-invariants.md.
